key_insight: A fully local, two-stage LLM pipeline can fill medical CRFs by first deciding whether evidence is present and then extracting values only when supported by the text.
clinical_relevance: This suggests privacy-preserving, on-premise clinical NLP systems can support structured data extraction from EHR notes without sending patient data to external APIs.
method: Used MedGemma-27B in a two-stage pipeline: binary presence classification followed by value extraction.
Applied item-specific few-shot in-context learning with strict handling of negated, uncertain, and unknown findings.
Kept the system fully local, with no external API calls or fine-tuning.
evidence_signal: On the official English test track, the approach reached a macro-F1 of 0.55 and ranked second among locally hosted open-source submissions.
watch_item: Performance is promising, but the setup still depends on careful item-specific prompting and may be sensitive to domain shift or incomplete textual evidence.
paper_title: sebis at CRF Filling 2026: A Two-Stage Local LLM Pipeline for Medical CRF Filling
